$comment: Spec for build-masters-feed.mjs. Copy to masters.feed.json, fill in your masters, BUMP `revision` on every publish (anti-downgrade). Each entry is encrypted + signed into the bundle the suite updater pulls daily. `payloadFile` reads JSON from disk; `payload` is inline. Use `common:<id>` for core-owned shared masters and `<appId>:<id>` for your app's own.
